args.content:
Hawaii Packing List

Based on the vacation itinerary for Hawaii (June 10-20, 2024), here are the essential items to pack:

Essential Items:
- Swimwear (for beach days, snorkeling, and kayaking)
- Sunscreen (essential for all outdoor activities)
- Hiking gear (for Diamond Head hike)
- Casual outfits (for shopping, dining, and relaxation)
- Camera (to capture memories at all locations)
- Travel documents (passport, tickets, hotel reservations)

Activity-Specific Items:
- Beach towel and flip-flops (Waikiki Beach, Kailua Beach)
- Snorkeling equipment (Hanauma Bay)
- Comfortable hiking shoes (Diamond Head)
- Light rain jacket (North Shore trip)
- Traditional Hawaiian attire (Luau experience)
- Shopping bags (Ala Moana Center)

Additional Recommendations:
- Sunglasses and hat
- Waterproof phone case
- First aid kit
- Insect repellent
- Portable charger
